Convention correctness at conditional C1; scientific status stays OPEN.

C2 closure/H3-conditional bracket; the target finding stays OPEN; scientific status OPEN.

C1 corrected supersession, not a rescue; the finding stays OPEN; scientific status OPEN.

PR-130 derives the exact zeta tail theorem for the registered toy response family (convergence domain exactly p > 1; p = 3/2 tail strictly positive at every finite L with a strict two-sided elementary bracket), certifies it with a three-engine enclosure (exact Fraction partial sum + remainder bracket, mpmath zeta with margin assertion, sympy identity), and rejects every sufficiency-type claim through the empty typed factorization registry with the toy family permanently barred; the audited NT2-A2 narrative is superseded (legacy module byte-frozen, narrative surfaces relabeled). C1 toy/transfer-conditional convergence theorem; the finding stays OPEN; scientific status OPEN.

PR-131 derives the exact class-conditional near-FLRW slaved-mode coefficients kappa = -2/(5+3w) and c2 = -2(9w^2+18w+13)/((3w+5)^2(9w+7)) on the named LRS-III/KS reduced system by two independent symbolic paths (invariance equation + metric-level Einstein reduction, both 2-plane signatures) with an arbitrary-precision FD plateau on both K branches under preregistered envelopes, and registers the exact singular map (resonance family w_n = -(2n+3)/(6n-3) + marginal boundaries) with the declared open domain (-1/3, 1) validated by exact monotone inversion. C2 class-conditional at fixed q0(w); the finding stays OPEN; scientific status OPEN.

PR-132 certifies the PR-131 slaved-mode prediction on the compact domain omk_domain_v1 (both branches) with the forward-invariant trapping tube |Sigma - (kappa K + c2 K^2)| <= |K|^3, proven uniformly by exact-Fraction interval branch-and-bound on the four boundary conditions and corroborated by direct integration, and propagates the remainder as an explicit component with four typed uncertainty components kept separate; the compact domain API is fail-closed and an in-domain enclosure escape blocks the claim. C2 class-conditional theorem with explicit remainder; the finding stays OPEN; scientific status OPEN.

PR-133 separates the pre-solver quantities into six distinct types (A_v proxy, Omega_tilt physical tilt, W2, Sigma, Delta_Omega_k, geometry) with a firewall and non-bridge guard, order-counts the harmonic boost (A_v O(beta), kinematic quadrupole O(beta^2)), keeps the analytic response rank equal to the PR-127 frozen rank 2 with the W2/Delta_Omega_k joint-null kernel (importing the map so it cannot contradict the frozen non-identification), surfaces the aligned-axis rank-1 exception under a window collinearity, and labels each candidate by its highest reached ladder rung with a resolving evidence pointer. C2 pre-solver discrimination diagnostic; no scalar family/geometry measurement; the finding stays OPEN; scientific status OPEN.

PR-134 builds the typed estimand/population/dependency/selection/nuisance registry: each analysis carries a fail-closed typed contract, five representative CF4/K1/DESI/ACT/JWST contracts are registered from documented metadata as specification records (no PR4 data run, no measurement), estimand and channel fingerprints reject flattening two surveys onto one channel, a post-hoc edit requires a new id and bumped multiplicity, dependence is a named cluster with a separator-robust independence guard, and the deterministic template-mean and stochastic covariance-factor branches stay separate. C1 estimand/analysis specification mechanics; the finding stays OPEN; scientific status OPEN.

PR-135 delivers the exchangeable observation-inclusive finite-null global ranking: the observation and every null row are scored and maximized identically, the global p-value is the Phipson-Smyth exact-discrete pooled rank (1+b)/(N+1) on the finite grid with a 1/(N+1) resolution floor and never zero, super-uniformity is shown by a real exact enumeration and a seeded type-I simulation with a sub-resolution negative control, the max-scan preserves within-row dependence by reducing to one score per row, and a load-bearing calibration/evaluation split, a sub-resolution sigma guard, and a non-zero floor gate are enforced. C2 matched-null-conditioned global calibration mechanics; the findings stay OPEN; scientific status OPEN.

PR-136 builds the partial-identification / identified-set engine over the PR-127 graded basis: an exact-Fraction axis-separable interval-intersection engine and a scipy HiGHS engine agree on the set status, the unbounded axes, and every bounded axis interval; the bounded/empty/unbounded/disconnected/undetermined topology is classified, the response-rank-deficiency case is unbounded along exactly the PR-127 kernel (bound live), full and subvector sets are reported separately as set-valued artifacts, and empty!=detection / broad!=central / nonconvergence!=non-identification are enforced. C2 formal identified-region mechanics; the findings stay OPEN; scientific status OPEN.

PR-137 measures the frozen Imbens-Manski confidence interval for grid-conditional simultaneous empirical coverage across a pre-registered point-to-unidentified DGP grid at the least-favorable boundary configuration, reports a genuine family-wise Bonferroni 99% lower bound with a pre-registered 10000-replicate extension for near-boundary points (minimum 0.9402, all retained), preserves an adversarial procedure's failures in a failure map, enforces a two-mesh kill condition, and refuses uniform class-wide language without a continuity/mesh certificate. C2 grid-conditional coverage-calibrated mechanics; the findings stay OPEN; scientific status OPEN.

PR-138 delivers lineage-bound posterior draws, simulation-based calibration, and replicated-data posterior-predictive checks on a conjugate Gaussian toy: the lineage is mandatory and verified on both the SBC and PPC paths, the known-good model passes the binned SBC rank-uniformity test while both known-bad models fail, the PPC computes Bayesian p-values over frozen content-addressed discrepancies with a demonstrated known-bad mis-specified failure, and caller predictions, discrepancy swaps, invalid posteriors, and residual-as-PPC are all refused. C2 model/transfer-conditional predictive-adequacy mechanics; the findings stay OPEN; scientific status OPEN.

J1-EXACT and J2-UNIFORM are REFUTED_OR_RESTRICTED in their registered general forms and cannot be promoted by this registry row; no FLRW proximity, observational validation, native-solver result, or Bianchi family identification is claimed.

Generic orbit separation, invariant-ring completeness, observed anomaly detection, source attribution, native-solver validation, and Bianchi family identification remain unproven and forbidden.
